description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named PathEffects that demonstrates the use of different PathEffect styles in custom drawing on a Canvas. It includes an inner class SampleView which handles rendering various path effects and user interaction to update the displayed path.

classes.name: PathEffects
classes.description: Main activity that initializes and displays the Path Effects demo.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View class that performs drawing operations to demonstrate different PathEffect styles and handles user input.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: makeDash
methods.description: Creates a DashPathEffect with a specific dash pattern and phase.

methods.name: makeEffects
methods.description: Populates an array of PathEffect objects with various effects, including dash, corner, compose, and PathDash effects.

methods.name: SampleView constructor
methods.description: Sets up the Paint object, creates the initial Path, initializes effects and colors, and prepares the view for rendering.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of path effects on the Canvas, updating the phase to animate the effects.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events to regenerate the path when the center D-Pad key is pressed.

methods.name: makeFollowPath
methods.description: Generates a random squiggly Path to demonstrate path effects.

methods.name: makePathDash
methods.description: Creates a Path to be used as a dash shape in PathDashPathEffect.
